source: decompiled 1.12.2 client: Entity* applyEntityAttributes / experienceValue, loot_tables/entities/*.json
attack_note: attack is the base ATTACK_DAMAGE in half-hearts; a held weapon adds its own damage, and hits on players are scaled by difficulty (Peaceful 0, Easy min(d/2+1, d), Normal d, Hard d*1.5). xp drops only if a player hit the mob recently.

mobs.name: bat
mobs.notes: Harmless flier; drops nothing.

mobs.name: blaze

drops.condition: killed by a player

mobs.notes: Fire-immune; shoots small fireballs (5 damage, sets you on fire); water and rain hurt it.

mobs.name: cave_spider

drops.condition: killed by a player; base roll -1..1, so about 1 in 3 without looting

mobs.notes: Its bite also poisons: 7 s on Normal, 15 s on Hard.

mobs.name: chicken

drops.condition: cooked if the mob dies on fire

mobs.notes: Lays an egg every 5-10 minutes; breeds with wheat, melon, pumpkin or beetroot seeds; a chicken jockey gives 10 xp.

mobs.name: cow

drops.condition: cooked if the mob dies on fire

mobs.notes: Use an empty bucket on an adult for milk; breeds with wheat.

mobs.name: creeper

rare.condition: killed by a skeleton's arrow: drops one random music disc (any of the 12)
killed by a charged creeper's explosion (one head per explosion); creeper head

mobs.notes: Explodes (power 3, 6 when charged) after a 1.5 s fuse once it reaches you.

mobs.name: donkey
mobs.notes: Tame by riding it until it accepts you; can carry a chest; breeds (tamed adults) with golden carrots or golden apples.

mobs.name: elder_guardian

drops.condition: this pool gives cod 3/6, prismarine crystals 2/6, nothing 1/6; cooked if the mob dies on fire
killed by a player; wet sponge

rare.condition: killed by a player; one roll on the fishing fish table; +1% per looting level

mobs.notes: Laser attack; its spikes deal 2 to melee attackers while it isn't moving; always drops a wet sponge when a player kills it.

mobs.name: ender_dragon
mobs.notes: No item drops; its xp is released over its death animation.

mobs.name: enderman
mobs.notes: Turns hostile when you look at its face (not with a pumpkin on your head); water and rain hurt it; teleports away from projectiles.

mobs.name: endermite
mobs.notes: Tiny melee mob; drops nothing.

mobs.name: evocation_illager

drops.condition: killed by a player

mobs.notes: Casts fang lines (6 damage each) and summons vexes; always drops a totem of undying.

mobs.name: ghast
mobs.notes: Fire-immune; shoots fireballs that explode (power 1) and hit for 6.

mobs.name: giant
mobs.notes: Has no AI tasks, so it never moves or attacks on its own.

mobs.name: guardian

drops.condition: this pool gives cod 2/5, prismarine crystals 2/5, nothing 1/5; cooked if the mob dies on fire

rare.condition: killed by a player; one roll on the fishing fish table; +1% per looting level

mobs.notes: Charging laser attack; its spikes deal 2 to melee attackers while it isn't moving.

mobs.name: horse
mobs.notes: Health, speed and jump vary per horse; tame by riding; breeds (tamed adults) with golden carrots or golden apples.

mobs.name: husk

rare.condition: killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds
killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds
killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds

mobs.notes: Zombie variant that does not burn in daylight; its hit adds Hunger.

mobs.name: illusion_illager
mobs.notes: Drops no items (empty loot table).

mobs.name: llama
mobs.notes: Spits for 1 damage; can carry a chest; breeds (tamed adults) with hay bales.

mobs.name: magma_cube

drops.condition: medium and large cubes only; base roll -2..1, so 1 in 4 without looting

mobs.notes: Fire-immune; splits into smaller cubes on death; every size can hurt you.

mobs.name: mooshroom

drops.condition: cooked if the mob dies on fire

mobs.notes: A bowl gives mushroom stew; shears turn it into a cow and drop 5 red mushrooms; breeds with wheat.

mobs.name: mule
mobs.notes: Tame by riding; can carry a chest.

mobs.name: ocelot
mobs.notes: Tame with raw fish (1 in 3 per feed); tamed ocelots breed with raw fish.

mobs.name: parrot
mobs.notes: Tame with any seeds (1 in 10 per feed); feeding it a cookie poisons and kills it.

mobs.name: pig

drops.condition: cooked if the mob dies on fire

mobs.notes: Breeds with carrots, potatoes or beetroot.

mobs.name: polar_bear

drops.condition: the roll gives cod 3 times in 4, otherwise raw salmon (meta 1)

mobs.notes: Neutral; adults attack players near a cub and join in when a cub is hurt.

mobs.name: rabbit

drops.condition: cooked if the mob dies on fire

rare.condition: killed by a player; +3% per looting level

mobs.notes: Breeds with carrots, golden carrots or dandelions.

mobs.name: sheep

drops.condition: only if not sheared; wool meta = fleece colour
cooked if the mob dies on fire

mobs.notes: Shears give 1-3 wool; eating grass regrows the fleece; breeds with wheat.

mobs.name: shulker

rare.condition: any death; +6.25% per looting level

mobs.notes: Bullets hit for 4 and give Levitation for 10 s; fire-immune.

mobs.name: silverfish
mobs.notes: Drops nothing.

mobs.name: skeleton

rare.condition: its held item; needs a recent player hit; +1% per looting level; drops damaged
killed by a charged creeper's explosion (one head per explosion); skeleton skull

mobs.notes: Shoots arrows; burns in daylight unless it wears a helmet; xp is 5 plus 1-3 for its bow.

mobs.name: skeleton_horse
mobs.notes: Undead horse; drops bones.

mobs.name: slime

drops.condition: smallest size only

mobs.notes: Splits into 2-4 smaller slimes on death; the smallest size can't hurt you.

mobs.name: snowman
mobs.notes: Throws snowballs at hostile mobs; water, rain and hot biomes (temperature > 1.0) hurt it.

mobs.name: spider

drops.condition: killed by a player; base roll -1..1, so about 1 in 3 without looting

mobs.notes: Climbs walls; won't pick a new target while it stands in bright light.

mobs.name: squid

drops.condition: ink sac

mobs.notes: Passive water mob; drops ink sacs.

mobs.name: stray

drops.condition: killed by a player; arrow of Slowness

rare.condition: its held item; needs a recent player hit; +1% per looting level; drops damaged

mobs.notes: Skeleton variant whose arrows add Slowness; burns in daylight unless it wears a helmet.

mobs.name: vex
mobs.notes: Flies through blocks; holds an iron sword that never drops; xp is 3 plus 1-3 for the sword.

mobs.name: villager
mobs.notes: Trades; drops nothing.

mobs.name: villager_golem

drops.condition: poppy

mobs.notes: Attacks hostile mobs; each hit deals 7-21 and throws the target upward.

mobs.name: vindication_illager

drops.condition: killed by a player

rare.condition: its held item; needs a recent player hit; +1% per looting level; drops damaged

mobs.notes: Melee with an iron axe (axe damage adds to its base 5); xp is 5 plus 1-3 for the axe.

mobs.name: witch

drops.condition: 1-3 rolls, each picks one of these 7 (stick twice as likely)

mobs.notes: Throws splash potions (harming, slowness, poison, weakness) and drinks potions to heal or resist.

mobs.name: wither
mobs.notes: Boss: wither skulls hit for 8 and add Wither (10 s Normal, 40 s Hard); fire-immune.

mobs.name: wither_skeleton

drops.condition: base roll -1..1, so about 1 in 3 without looting

rare.condition: killed by a player; wither skeleton skull; +1% per looting level
its held item; needs a recent player hit; +1% per looting level; drops damaged
killed by a charged creeper's explosion (one head per explosion); wither skeleton skull

mobs.notes: Fire-immune; hits add Wither for 10 s; base 4 plus its stone sword.

mobs.name: wolf
mobs.notes: Neutral until hit; tame with bones (1 in 3 per bone); tamed wolves breed with any meat incl. rotten flesh.

mobs.name: zombie

rare.condition: killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds
killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds
killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds
killed by a charged creeper's explosion (one head per explosion); zombie head

mobs.notes: Burns in daylight unless it wears a helmet (babies never burn); babies give 12 xp; +1-3 xp per equipped item.

mobs.name: zombie_horse
mobs.notes: Undead horse; drops rotten flesh.

mobs.name: zombie_pigman

rare.condition: killed by a player; +1% per looting level
its held item; needs a recent player hit; +1% per looting level; drops damaged

mobs.notes: Neutral until a player hits it, then nearby pigmen join in; fire-immune; holds a golden sword.

mobs.name: zombie_villager

rare.condition: killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds
killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds
killed by a player; one roll at 2.5% (+1% per looting level) picks iron ingot, carrot or potato with equal odds

mobs.notes: Burns in daylight like a zombie; cure it with a plain golden apple while it has Weakness.
